detail.longDescription: Hi HN, I'm Dat. I started building TablePro last December because I want a native, open-source database client for Mac. I already used TablePlus there before with free but have too much limit, so I built my own. TablePro is written in Swift and currently supports more than 30 databases. It’s lightweight and very fast. The app core is free, other extra features like iCloud Sync, ... are paid to help fund development. TablePro also has an available iOS/iPad version on App Store, and a Linux version built with GTK4/Rust in development. Would love to hear what you think.
